name: Beta-Neoendorphin
summary: β-Neoendorphin is an endogenous opioid peptide with a nonapeptide structure and the amino acid sequence Tyr-Gly-Gly-Phe-Leu-Arg-Lys-Tyr-Pro (YGGFLRKYP). It's one of the two neoendorphins.

pharmacology.en: It is a nine amino acid peptide cut from prodynorphin. It acts on opioid receptors, with a preference for the kappa receptor, which dampens pain signals.
pharmacology.zh: 它是由九個胺基酸組成、切自 prodynorphin 的胜肽。它作用於鴉片受體並偏好 kappa 受體，從而抑制疼痛訊號。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是由九个胺基酸组成、切自 prodynorphin 的胜肽。它作用于鸦片受体并偏好 kappa 受体，从而抑制疼痛信号。

uses.en: It is not a medicine. It is studied in the laboratory to understand the body's own opioid system.
uses.zh: 它不是藥物，而是實驗室研究的對象，用來了解身體自身的鴉片系統。
uses.zhHans: 它不是药物，而是实验室研究的对象，用来了解身体自身的鸦片系统。

fact.en: It is alpha-neoendorphin with the last amino acid trimmed off. Both begin with the same five amino acids as leucine enkephalin, a signature shared by the body's own opioids.
fact.zh: 它是 α-新內啡肽去掉最後一個胺基酸後的產物。兩者的前五個胺基酸都與白胺酸腦磷肽相同，這是體內自生鴉片物質共有的特徵。
fact.zhHans: 它是 α-新内啡肽去掉最后一个胺基酸后的产物。两者的前五个胺基酸都与白胺酸脑磷肽相同，这是体内自生鸦片物质共有的特征。
